name: LYGO LLM Console - session vault (session history, catalog, long-term continuity)
purpose: A finished conversation is filed, labelled, indexed, zipped and findable again - by the operator and by the agent - so 'New session' can never cost the chat it wipes, and a thread can be reopened months later with its context carried forward.

/api/session: new (now reports where the chat was filed)

invariants: nothing is deleted: filing copies, it never moves or removes
the journal and the legacy session files stay exactly where they were
filing twice replaces the catalog line instead of duplicating it
every zip is reopened, CRC-checked and compared byte-for-byte before a session is called filed
session folders are <id>-<slug>: prefix-matchable by id, readable by title
a filed session always carries a digest built without an LLM call
reopening files the conversation being interrupted first
a broken vault answers sessions_unavailable and never raises into a turn or a boot

evidence.hashes: both installs byte-identical for every file below

defects_found_and_fixed: the record state schema keeps only declared keys, so resume lineage and the last-filed report were written and silently dropped on read -> keys declared, state read back after write
digest.md was a 26-byte stub because build_carry() reads rollups a live conversation has not produced yet -> _digest_for() builds the thread from the turns
the panel's Find box and the route disagreed (hits vs catalog rows) -> ?q= filters the catalog, ?search=1&q= searches transcripts, the panel renders both and falls back
the e2e harness redirected the record's dirs but not the vault's -> it now sandboxes the vault too, so a test can never file into the operator's vault
roadmap: boot-verify the USB stick against this build
hand seal() straight into the vault month folders instead of a flat save/archive
fold the stick's pre-vault current.json in through adopt once the first new session is started
rebrand_refresh_note: image_info now reads through the mapped read roots instead of silently rewriting an outside path into the workspace (a real picture reported 'does not exist'); tool description updated in limbs.py
